title: K-Opioid receptor agonist

source.dataset: psychonautwiki_db.zip (psychonautwiki.db, SQLite export provided by Hany, file dated 2026-11-25)

plain_text:
245px|thumbnail|Salvinorin A - The commonly used k-opioid receptor agonist.
κ-Opioid receptor agonists are psychoactive drugs, which induce atypical hallucinogenic effects.
They bind to the kappa opioid receptors with varying affinities.

Examples

* Mirtazapine
* Salvinorin A
* Salvinorin B
* Ibogaine

See also

* Responsible use
* Dissociative
* Antagonist

External links

*κ-opioid receptor (Wikipedia)
